# Discoveries with fixed parameters. VARIABLE_DISCOVERY_SET picks the
# controller model, which titles the matcher.
VARIABLE_BRIDGE
VARIABLE dual_sense_target_name DUALSENSE
VARIABLE dual_sense_version 5
  VARIABLE_STATE "DualSense (PS5)" 5
  VARIABLE_STATE "DualSense Edge (PS5)" 5edge
  VARIABLE_STATE "DualShock 4 v1 (PS4)" 4
VARIABLE dual_sense_serial_num None
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3.discovery.hid_discovery 0x054C 0x05C4
    VARIABLE_DISCOVERY_SET dual_sense_version 4
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/hid_discovery.py 0x054C 0x0CE6
    VARIABLE_DISCOVERY_SET dual_sense_version 5
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3.discovery.hid_discovery 0x054C 0x0DF2
    VARIABLE_DISCOVERY_SET dual_sense_version 5edge

TARGET DUALSENSE <%= dual_sense_target_name %>
